data.name: Athey
data.gender_notes: Athey is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Athey is recorded in name-lists as “Fire, Bright”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Athey expresses “Fire, Bright”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Athey total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: Athey
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Athey הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'æðel', meaning 'noble'. The 'A' prefix means 'fire, bright'. This name can be used for both males and females in the Christian tradition.

in_greek.name: Athey
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Fire, Bright
in_greek.long_meaning: Athey είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English word 'æðel', meaning 'noble'. The 'A' prefix means 'fire, bright'. This name can be used for both males and females in the Christian tradition.

in_latin.name: Athey
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Fire, Bright
in_latin.long_meaning: Athey est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English word 'æðel', meaning 'noble'. The 'A' prefix means 'fire, bright'. This name can be used for both males and females in the Christian tradition.
